name: Shaneorka
source:
The third member of the "Imouto" group. Her full name is Shaneorka Miravona Bryusov, but is seldom called that because of its difficulty. Nicknamed Chanelle by her friends. 

A good cook and has all of the features of an ideal wife. Diminutive and understanding, she acts as the motherly figure of the party.
